cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a martial training yard with weapon racks — holds her keepsake at chest height; A secluded mountain bathing pool under an old stone aqueduct in early afternoon — She skips one flat pebble across the still mountain pool; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; overgrown jungle temple ruins — standing; An open-air tea stop beside a terraced pear orchard — She shares a freshly cut pear with an unseen travelling companion; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lying on her front; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — seated on a chair; a domed marble hammam with warm stone slabs and brass bowls — paints a nail with the brush from a small bottle of nail polish; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds a microphone close to her lips; a Peking opera dressing room — standing; a cedar-wood tub by the window of a mountain inn — dries her hair with a towel
